name: Riesbyfe Stridberg
original_name: リーズバイフェ・ストリンドヴァリ
source: Riesbyfe was a vampire hunter from the Church and a leader of the knight's heresy persecution group. She is also a friend of Sion Eltnam Atlasia and died rescuing her from Wallachia three years before the events of Melty Blood. Even after resurrecting as another materialization of TATARI, she's still hasn't been absorbed by it, thanks to her Holy Shield, Gamaliel.
translation: Riesbyfe was a vampire hunter from the Church and a leader of the knight's heresy persecution group. She is also a friend of Sion Eltnam Atlasia and died rescuing her from Wallachia three years before the events of Melty Blood. Even after resurrecting as another materialization of TATARI, she's still hasn't been absorbed by it, thanks to her Holy Shield, Gamaliel.
